user.title: Connect to Ethos
user.description: Enter your Ethos server URL. Home Assistant then signs in as you, in one of the ways your Ethos instance offers.

data_description.url: Base URL of your Ethos server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000

method.title: Sign in to Ethos
method.description: How do you want to sign in?

menu_options.browser: Sign in with {provider} in your browser

email.title: Sign in by email
email.description: Enter the email you sign in to Ethos with.

link.title: Paste the sign-in link
link.description: Ethos has emailed a sign-in link to {email}. Paste the whole link, or just its token. Links last 15 minutes.

browser_retry.title: Sign in with {provider}
browser_retry.description: The sign-in didn't finish. Submit to get a new code and try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Ethos again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant's sign-in for {url} has expired or was revoked. Continue to sign in again.

progress.wait_for_approval: Open [{url}]({url}) and sign in with {provider}. Check that the code shown there is **{code}**, then approve Home Assistant. This window carries on by itself once you have.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Ethos server. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.cannot_connect_provider: Failed to reach the sign-in provider. Check that it is running and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.invalid_link: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired (links last 15 minutes). Start again to get a new one.
error.request_refused: Ethos refused to send a sign-in link. Check the address. This Ethos instance may not be set up to send email (SMTP_URL).
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
error.device_expired: The code expired before it was approved.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Ethos account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in is for a different Ethos account than this entry belongs to.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Ethos server.
abort.cannot_connect_provider: Failed to reach the sign-in provider. Check that it is running and that Home Assistant can reach it.
abort.no_sign_in_method: This Ethos instance offers no way for Home Assistant to sign in. Its admin needs to set up email (SMTP_URL) or a sign-in provider.
abort.device_sign_in_off: This Ethos instance signs in with {provider}, but device sign-in isn't set up. Its admin needs to register a device client at {provider} and set OIDC_DEVICE_CLIENT_ID on Ethos.
abort.device_start_failed: {provider} refused to start a device sign-in. Check that the Home Assistant client has the device grant and is allowed for the Ethos API.
abort.token_refused: Ethos didn't accept the sign-in from {provider}. Sign in to Ethos in your browser with {provider} once, so Ethos links the account, then try again.

mark_habit.name: Mark habit
mark_habit.description: Records a day of a habit in Ethos: kept, or deliberately skipped. Marking a day again rewrites it.

day.name: Day
day.description: The day to mark. Defaults to today, in Home Assistant's time zone.

status.name: Status
status.description: Done (kept) or skipped (deliberately declined; at most two a period).

partial.name: Smaller version
partial.description: You did less than you meant to. Still a kept day, counted whole. Only with status done.

clear_habit.name: Clear habit
clear_habit.description: Removes a day's entry, leaving it untouched rather than missed.

day.name: Day
day.description: The day to clear. Defaults to today, in Home Assistant's time zone.
